title: Evidence Failures by Page
app: Evidence (code-based BI) build and query logs via CI/UF to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=evidence:build status="failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by page
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Evidence failures grouped by page so operators immediately see which specific pages are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Evidence is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Evidence failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical pages.
visualization: Table of page by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Evidence are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
